texts.SamplePageMessage: A sample page for the Operations module
texts.Operations:PurchaseOrders:BranchAccessDe: You can only act on purchase orders for a branch you manage.
texts.PurchaseOrders:Subtitle: Incoming stock orders from suppliers.
texts.NoPurchaseOrders: No purchase orders match these filters
texts.POHint:DraftMine: Add the products to order, then press Submit to send it for approval.
texts.POHint:Draft: Draft — waiting to be completed and submitted.
texts.POHint:SubmittedApprover: Review the order lines and approve so the delivery can be received.
texts.POHint:ApprovedReceiver: Approved. When the delivery arrives, press "Receive items" and enter the quantities that came in.
texts.POHint:Approved: Approved — waiting for the delivery to arrive.
texts.POHint:Partial: Partially received — receive the remaining items when the rest of the delivery arrives.
texts.ConfirmCancelPO: Cancel this purchase order? This cannot be undone.
texts.ConfirmApprovePO: Approve this order? Once approved, items can be received.
texts.PurchaseOrders:NewIntro: Step 1 of 2 — set up the order header. You'll add products in the next step.
texts.PurchaseOrderCreatedToast: Purchase order {0} created — check the items, then submit it.
texts.ReceiveAtLeastOne: Enter the quantity that arrived for at least one item.
texts.ReceiveDialogHint: Enter what actually arrived. For perishable products, record the expiry date printed on the received batch.
texts.ReceiveExpiryRequired: Enter the received batch expiry date for '{0}'.
texts.ReceiveExpiryInPast: The expiry date for '{0}' is already past and cannot be received.
texts.Validation:ReceiveLinesRequired: Enter a received quantity for at least one item.
texts.Validation:ReceiveLinesUnique: Do not repeat the same item in one receipt.
texts.Validation:ReceiveQuantityPositive: Received quantity must be greater than zero.
texts.Validation:CurrencyLength: Currency code must be exactly 3 characters.
texts.Validation:CurrencyIso: Enter a 3-letter uppercase ISO currency code, such as USD.
texts.Validation:ExpectedDeliveryBeforeOrder: Expected delivery date cannot be earlier than the order date.
texts.Validation:OrderedQuantityPositive: Ordered quantity must be greater than zero.
texts.Validation:SourceDestinationDifferent: Source and destination branches must be different.
texts.Validation:RequestedQuantityPositive: Requested quantity must be greater than zero.
texts.Validation:TransferLinesRequired: Select at least one transfer line.
texts.Validation:TransferredQuantityNonNegativ: Received transfer quantity cannot be negative.
texts.Validation:InvoiceNumberMax64: Invoice number must not exceed 64 characters.
texts.Validation:QuantityPositive: Quantity must be greater than zero.
texts.PurchaseOrderFullyReceivedToast: Purchase order {0} fully received — the stock has been added.
texts.PurchaseOrderPartiallyReceivedToast: Purchase order {0} partially received — the rest stays open for the next delivery.
texts.Operations:PurchaseOrders:CannotModifyAf: Order can only be modified while in Draft status (current: {CurrentStatus}).
texts.Operations:PurchaseOrders:CannotSubmitEm: Cannot submit an order with no items.
texts.Operations:PurchaseOrders:ReceivedExceed: Received quantity ({Requested}) exceeds remaining ordered quantity for this item.
texts.Operations:PurchaseOrders:DuplicateProdu: This product is already on the order.
texts.Operations:PurchaseOrders:InvalidQuantit: Quantity must be greater than zero.
texts.Operations:PurchaseOrders:ExpiryRequired: Enter the received batch expiry date for '{ProductName}'.
texts.Operations:PurchaseOrders:ExpiryInPast: '{ProductName}' cannot be received with an expired date ({ExpiryDate}).
texts.Sales:Subtitle: Recorded sales transactions.
texts.SaleDeleteConfirm: Delete sale {0}? The sold items will be returned to stock, and the sale disappears from reports.
texts.Operations:Sales:DuplicateInvoiceNumber: Invoice number '{InvoiceNumber}' is already used. Invoice numbers must be unique.
texts.Operations:Sales:CannotRecordEmptySale: A sale must have at least one product.
texts.Operations:Sales:DuplicateProduct: This product is already on the sale.
texts.Operations:Sales:InsufficientStock: Not enough stock — requested {Requested}, only {Available} available.
texts.Operations:Sales:IncludesExpiredStock: This sale cannot be completed because there is not enough usable stock of: {Products}. Remove expired units and review the batch ledger first.
texts.Operations:Sales:ItemNotFound: The requested sale line could not be found.
texts.Operations:Sales:BatchHistoryMissing: This older sale cannot be voided automatically because the expiry-batch history for '{ProductName}' was not stored. Record a supervised stock adjustment with the correct expiry date.
texts.Operations:Sales:NoInventoryRow: Product has no inventory at this branch.
texts.Operations:Sales:BranchAccessDenied: You don't have access to record sales for this branch.
texts.Operations:Cashier:NoOpenShift: You don't have an open cash shift at this branch. Open a shift before selling.
texts.Operations:Cashier:ShiftAlreadyOpen: You already have an open cash shift. Close it before opening another.
texts.Operations:Cashier:InvalidOpeningFloat: The opening float cannot be negative.
texts.Operations:Cashier:VoidWindowExpired: This sale can no longer be voided — the {WindowMinutes}-minute void window has passed. Ask a manager to void it.
texts.Operations:Cashier:SaleAlreadyVoided: This sale has already been voided.
texts.Operations:Cashier:BranchNotAssignedToCa: You can only operate the branch assigned to you. Contact your manager if this is wrong.
texts.Operations:Cashier:BranchNotManagedByYou: You can only create or assign cashiers for branches you manage.
texts.Operations:Cashier:SaleAccessDenied: You can only view or change cashier sales recorded during your own shift.
texts.Operations:Cashier:CashTenderedInsuffici: Cash tendered ({Tendered}) is less than the sale total ({Total}). Collect the full amount before charging.
texts.StockTransfers:Subtitle: Request stock, approve, ship and receive between branches.
texts.ChooseSourceBranchHint: Choose the branch that will prepare and ship this request.
texts.NewTransferIntro: Choose the receiving branch and add the products you need. The admin or kitchen assigns the source branch after you submit.
texts.NewTransferIntroChooser: Choose the branches and add the products. You can still edit the items before submitting.
texts.NoReceivingBranchAvailable: No receiving branch is available for this transfer.
texts.TransferCreatedToast: Transfer {0} created — review the items and submit.
texts.SameBranchWarning: Source and destination branches must be different.
texts.CompleteTransferHint: Confirm the quantity that actually arrived for each item. The received stock is added to your branch.
texts.TransferShipShortInfo: You are shipping less than the approved quantity. Only the amount you enter will leave the source branch.
texts.ShipLeavesSourceHint: Stock leaves {0} the moment you confirm.
texts.TransferReportLostConfirm: Nothing arrived? This closes the transfer with zero received. The stock that left the source is recorded as lost in transit and cannot be recovered.
texts.TransferCompleteStockShortage: The source branch does not have enough stock of {0} right now — {1} requested, {2} available.
texts.TransferReceiveOverShipped: You can't receive more of {0} than was shipped ({1}).
texts.TransferReceiveShortWarn: You are receiving less than was shipped. The missing quantity will be recorded as lost in transit.
texts.TransferSourceStockMissingNow: The source branch does not have enough stock for this transfer right now. Check the source branch's stock before shipping or receiving.
texts.TransferBranchActionDenied: This action must be done by the manager of the correct branch.
texts.TransferSubmitted: Request submitted — the approver has been notified.
texts.TransferApproved: Request approved — the source branch can now ship.
texts.TransferSourceAssigned: Source branch assigned and request approved — the source branch can now ship.
texts.TransferShipped: Marked in transit — stock has left your branch.
texts.TransferRejected: Request rejected — the requesting branch can see your reason.
texts.TransferCompleted: Transfer {0} received — stock added to your branch.
texts.RejectReasonHint: The requesting branch will see this reason.
texts.CancelConfirmText: Cancel this transfer? This cannot be undone.
texts.SourceBranchOptionalHint: Leave empty to let the admin choose where the stock comes from.
texts.SourceDecidedByAdmin: Assigned by the admin after you submit
texts.NewTransferFixHighlighted: Please fill in the highlighted fields before submitting.
texts.AtLeastOneProductRequired: Add at least one product with a quantity.
texts.SourceRequiredForOtherBranch: To send stock to another branch, first choose the source branch you manage.
texts.NoActionTransfers: Nothing is waiting for you — all transfers are moving along.
texts.Hint:DraftMine: Add the products you need, then press "Submit request".
texts.Hint:DraftOther: This request is still being prepared by {0}.
texts.Hint:PendingApprover: Review the quantities, choose which branch will send the stock, then approve — or reject with a reason.
texts.Hint:PendingApproverWithSource: Review the quantities and approve — or reject with a reason.
texts.Hint:PendingOther: Waiting for the admin or kitchen manager to review and approve this request.
texts.Hint:ApprovedShipper: Prepare the items and press "Ship now". Stock leaves your branch the moment you confirm.
texts.Hint:ApprovedOther: Approved — waiting for {0} to prepare and ship the goods.
texts.Hint:InTransitReceiver: The goods are on their way to you. When they arrive, press "Receive items" and confirm the quantities.
texts.Hint:InTransitOther: On its way — waiting for {0} to confirm the goods arrived.
texts.Notif:ToShip: {0} transfer(s) ready to ship from your branch
texts.Notif:TransferToast: A stock transfer needs your attention
texts.Operations:Transfers:CannotModifyAfterDr: Transfer can only be modified while in Draft status (current: {CurrentStatus}).
texts.Operations:Transfers:CannotSubmitEmptyTr: Cannot submit a transfer with no items.
texts.Operations:Transfers:DuplicateProduct: This product is already on the transfer.
texts.Operations:Transfers:SameBranch: Source and destination branches must be different.
texts.Operations:Transfers:InsufficientStock: The source branch does not have this product now — requested {Requested}, available {Available}.
texts.Operations:Transfers:InvalidQuantity: Quantity must be zero or greater.
texts.Operations:Transfers:CannotApproveItem: Quantities can only be adjusted while the request is waiting approval or approved (current: {CurrentStatus}).
texts.Operations:Transfers:SourceBranchRequire: Choose a source branch before approving or shipping this transfer.
texts.Operations:Transfers:RejectionReasonRequ: Please write a short reason so the requesting branch knows why it was rejected.
texts.Operations:Transfers:ReceivedExceedsShip: Received quantity ({Received}) cannot exceed the shipped quantity ({Shipped}).
texts.Operations:Transfers:CannotShipNothing: Enter a quantity for at least one item before shipping.
